flag.name: TT_BIO_SDPA_GRID_Q_CHUNK

arms.on: shipped default, the grid rule picks the q_chunk

flag.switch: module attribute plus cache_clear on _grid_q_chunk, _sdpa_q_chunk and _sdpa_program_config_for_shape, inside one process and one device context
flag.question: the SIGN of a default-ON flag, not a new lever

seed_floor_context_A.metric: maximum independently superposed domain all-atom float64 Kabsch RMSD, split after residue 298; also report whole-chain all-atom
seed_floor_context_A.cross_arm: the flag changes a grid decision, so the CIF digest is compared between arms; a moved digest is scored in Angstrom against the size bar, not an automatic kill
